# Australian Public Service (Federal)
## APS Salary Guide by Classification
### APS 6 Salary
AnAPS 6 (also written as APS6 or APS Level 6) earns **$101,855–$111,701** gross — roughly $79,000–$84,000 take-home after income tax and Medicare, plus15.4% employer super (~$118,000–$129,000 total package).
